isr: isr: { expiration: 60, bypassToken: SANITY_PREVIEW_SECRET || undefined, exclude: [/^\/api\//] }

isr: {
      expiration: false,
      bypassToken: process.env.CMS_REVALIDATE_TOKEN,
      /**
       * The CMS must never be cached. Both slash forms are listed because
       * `vercel.json` sets `trailingSlash: true`; `scripts/fix-isr-routes.mjs`
       * patches the generated route table after the build and verifies it.
       */
      exclude: [
        '/admin', '/admin/',
        '/preview', '/preview/',
        '/api/session', '/api/session/',
        '/api/content', '/api/content/',
        '/api/config', '/api/config/',
        '/api/media', '/api/media/',
        '/api/cloudinary', '/api/cloudinary/',
        '/api/publish', '/api/publish/',
      ],
    }

exclude:
/^\/api\//,
				/^\/tavern\/edit\//,
				/^\/tavern\/login/,
				/^\/tavern\/library/,
				/^\/tavern\/admin/,
				/^\/tavern\/set-password/,
				/^\/tavern\/scheduling/,
				// Article pages fetch live content from GitHub — must not be cached
				/^\/tavern\/wiki(?:\/|$)/,
				/^\/studio\/blog\//,

/^\/api\/.+/,
              /.*\/filtr.*/, // Exclude any URL containing "/filtr"
              /.*\/filter.*/, // Exclude any URL containing "/filtr"
